title: 安定
tagline: Antei: trustless liquid vaults leveraging ethereum account abstraction BLS signatures
description: Antei vaults are controlled by a network of erc-4332 BLS smart contract wallets, and for every vote-Escorewed or locked token you deposit, our network will mint a GHO token, leveraging 1inch fusion. Our first interface we supported is Velodrome a DEX where users lock VELO tokens, where they then receive a NFT.
how_its_made: We started with Gnosis and Safe but they didn't support the networks we wanted to so we moved to Lit and a few other open source libraries. We waned to build a Metamask snap to enable BLS signing but didn't have time. We burned a bunch of time trying to deplouy our own account abstraction contracts on Gnosis Testnet but their nodes dont support it.
